newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sahaviriya cuts Thai steel production.
newsitem.headline: Sahaviriya cuts Thai steel production.

text.p: Sahaviriya Steel Industries Plc said on Wednesday it has started cutting down production of hot-rolled coil steel at its southern Prachuab Khirikhan mill due to an oversupply of the metal in Thailand.
President Adisak Lowjun told Reuters in an interview that production would eventually be cut for this calendar year to around 1.3 million tonnes from an earlier projected 1.8 million tonnes.

The action was being taken to counter a steel oversupply resulting from excessive imports of cheaper product and also because the company was stuck with about unsold steel product worth 2.0 billion baht at its warehouse, he said.

"More than 200,000 tonnes of hot-rolled coil steel is now left unsold at the warehouse due to imports of cheaper metal from several countries including Russia, Ukraine, China, North Korea and Mexico," said Adisak.
He said the production cut would affect the company's revenue in future.
"My company's production has been cut and I don't want to think about falling revenue. I feel sad every time I think about it," Adisak said.
